# My Modern Met

> > My Modern Met celebrates creativity through contemporary art, design, photography, and architecture from around the world.

My Modern Met is a leading online magazine featuring artists like Ed Fairburn, Eduardo Kobra, and Marta Bevacqua, showcasing everything from portrait photography and surreal collages to innovative architecture and nature-inspired crafts. The site covers diverse creative disciplines including contemporary art, design innovations, wildlife photography, and cultural phenomena.

## Key Topics

- Contemporary Art
- Portrait Photography
- Portrait Art
- Surrealism
- Architecture & Design
- Animal Photography
- Nature-Inspired Art
- Collage Art
- Sculpture & 3D Art
- Watercolor Painting
- Street Art & Murals
- Vintage Photography
- Marine Wildlife
- Handcrafted Objects
- Installation Art

## Contemporary Art & Sculpture

- [Remarkable 240-Year-Old Doll Automaton Can Write Actual Programmable Text](https://mymodernmet.com/jaquet-droz-automata): Pierre Jaquet-Droz's 1770s programmable writing automaton 'The Writer'
- [Fantastical Clouds Magically Suspended in Empty Rooms](https://mymodernmet.com/berndnaut-smilde-antipode-nimbus): Berndnaut Smilde's Nimbus series creates indoor clouds at Ronchini Gallery
- [Amazingly Intricate Laser-Cut Wood Relief Sculptures by Gabriel Schama](https://mymodernmet.com/gabriel-schama-laser-cut-wood-sculptures): Gabriel Schama's layered mahogany plywood relief sculptures from Oakland
- [Artist Designs DIY Paper Templates for Adorable 3D Geometric Animals](https://mymodernmet.com/paperwolf-diy-paper-sculptures): Paperwolf's geometric animal DIY paper sculpture templates on Etsy
- [Intricately Hard-Carved Wooden Spoons Pay Homage to Nature with Decorative Handles](https://mymodernmet.com/giles-newman-wood-carved-spoons): Giles Newman's hand-carved decorative wooden spoons from North Wales

## Portrait Photography & Art

- [Interview: Quietly Expressive Faces of Women Whose Eyes Tell a Story](https://mymodernmet.com/behind-the-lens-marta-bevacqua): Photographer Marta Bevacqua discusses her expressive women's portraits
- [New Evocative Portraits Harmoniously Blend with Paper Maps](https://mymodernmet.com/ed-fairburn-face-landscapes): Ed Fairburn's portrait art drawn on paper maps at Mike Wright Gallery
- [Alluring Watercolor Paintings Prove that Eyes are Windows to the Soul](https://mymodernmet.com/jone-bengoa-watercolor-eye-paintings): Spanish artist Jone Bengoa's realistic watercolor eye portraits
- [Fairytale-like Photos of Russian Models Posing with a Real Bear](https://mymodernmet.com/olga-barantseva-bear-russian-models): Olga Barantseva's anti-hunting campaign photos with bear Stepan near Moscow
- [Professional Portraits of Hairless Dogs Captures Their Hilarious Expressions](https://mymodernmet.com/sophie-gamand-hairless-dogs-series): Sophie Gamand photographs Chinese Crested and Xoloitzcuintli dogs

## Surreal & Collage Art

- [Vintage Photos Fuse to Create Fantastically Surreal Landscape Collages](https://mymodernmet.com/eugenia-loli-collages): California artist Eugenia Loli creates surreal vintage photo collages
- [Dreamy Portraits Fuse Human Faces with Nature and Architecture](https://mymodernmet.com/antonio-mora-surreal-portraits): Antonio Mora's double exposure portraits merging faces with landscapes
- [Surreal Paintings Blur the Line Between Fact and Fantasy](https://mymodernmet.com/neil-simone-surreal-paintings): London artist Neil Simone's layered surrealist paintings
- [Colorful Solo Show Titled "Peace" by Eduardo Kobra](https://mymodernmet.com/eduardo-kobra-solo-show-peace): Eduardo Kobra's 'Peace' exhibition at Dorothy Circus Gallery in Rome

## Architecture & Design Innovation

- [Mountainside Memorial Features 100 Blooming Gardens That Change with the Seasons](https://mymodernmet.com/awaji-yumebutai-100-stepped-garden): Tadao Ando's Awaji Yumebutai earthquake memorial with 100 stepped gardens
- [3D Printed Underwater City Plans to Recycle Rubbish into "Seascrapers"](https://mymodernmet.com/ocean-skyscrapers): Vincent Callebaut's Aequorea underwater city design from recycled waste
- [Foldable Transparent Carport Protects and Shows Off Prized Vehicles](https://mymodernmet.com/gazebox-foldable-carport): GazeBox foldable transparent carport for vehicle protection and display
- [Redesigned Women's Bathroom Sign Breaks Old Stereotypes to Become Empowering](https://mymodernmet.com/it-was-never-a-dress-campaign): Axosoft's 'It Was Never a Dress' campaign reimagines bathroom signage

## Nature & Wildlife Photography

- [Thousands of Giant Jellyfish Appear in Swarms off Britain's Coast](https://mymodernmet.com/barrel-jellyfish-swarms-in-britain): Giant Barrel Jellyfish swarms photographed off Britain's coast
